items.title: Joseph's brothers
items.charge: Conspiracy to murder; selling a brother; deceiving their father with a bloodied coat

items.title: Peter's denial
items.charge: Denying Christ three times with cursing and swearing

items.title: Stephen
items.charge: Full of faith and of the Holy Ghost; a face like an angel before the council; forgiving those who stoned him

items.title: The false witnesses against Stephen
items.charge: Suborning witnesses and stirring up the council against a man they could not answer
